title: Tomba Clearbit-Person Actor Input
description: Input schema for the Tomba Clearbit-Person Actor that enriches person information using the Tomba API.

emails.title: Emails to Enrich
emails.description: Array of email addresses to enrich with person information.

maxResults.title: Maximum Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of people to enrich. Default is 50.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many Tomba requests run in parallel. There is no rate limit, so raise it for large lists.
maxConcurrency.sectionDescription: Concurrency, retry and cache settings. The defaults work well for most runs.

maxRetries.title: Max retries
maxRetries.description: How many times to retry a request after a network error, 429 or 5xx response (exponential backoff). Failed requests are never charged.

useCache.title: Use cache
useCache.description: Reuse results from previous runs for identical requests. Cached results are free.

cacheTtlHours.title: Cache TTL (hours)
cacheTtlHours.description: How long cached results stay valid. 0 disables the cross-run cache.
